body: 13 Nov 2026 night, DECISIONS made by the advisor in the owner's name (he is away and said: do it yourself, the advisor decides). (1) P0-16 stays pending: it blocks nothing; do not raise it again. (2) N-19 continues without his input, starting from the lead that the lost pause may be the toggle path (togglePlayPause picks pause only when _sounding || _loadingToPlay > 0; _loadingToPlay rises only inside _loadCurrent, after the look): a tap is not 'about to play' during the look. N-19 stays open until the 'no connection' notice is actually seen. (3) Agents: the lead plus up to two helpers, code only, in disjoint areas: N-24 (artist page) and N-25 (playlist page). N-23 (typo tolerance) waits for a short note on where matching lives (ADR-R42, B-46: the server owns matching) which the advisor rules on; this SKIPS the board order (N-23 is #7) on purpose. If check.ps1 takes more than about 25 minutes or perf tests turn flaky, drop to one helper. (4) Merges: the advisor checkpoint stays, batched. (5) The walk follows RELEASE-CANDIDATE.md exactly: VM 108 rolled back to the 'clean' snapshot and the image installed by the guide; the image tag is sha-7c7fa60 (the last server change, #6) and the evidence must show git diff --stat 7c7fa60 270e2a8 -- server/encore_server is empty; the APK is built locally at 270e2a8 (android-debug-build only proves it compiles and uploads nothing) with a versionCode above 144; never the owner's A35; at most 10 YouTube look-ups per run; VM start/stop and the undo logged in local/homelab-changes-2026-11-13.md. (6) N-11 is proven on the same bench with a debug build on a second emulator (run-as): the duplicate-file_id query at sign-in, after 1 and after 3 minutes (RELEASE-CANDIDATE B1/F30: a fresh sign-in stays in the old music-server mode for about two minutes). (7) N-24 and N-25 add screens: the drawing comes first (docs/design/00-screen-inventory.md and the directions; if the state is not drawn the first PR is the drawing, copying Spotify's pattern); pictures that change follow goldens.yml's own steps (dispatch on the branch, look at the committed pictures, then dispatch app.yml), never --update-goldens locally.
